case_verdicts.reason: R2 stored object metadata/body boundary with UTF-8 size, metadata-only head and opaque ETag relationships.
R2 value conversion accepts sliced DataView and Blob; distinct __r2Value/native upload path, without an admission-time mutation claim.
Finite public streaming put chunk bridge handles empty chunk and EOF before accepted object read.
R2 metadata envelope roundtrip and writeHttpMetadata projection including Date revival and Unicode custom values.
Full object overwrite replaces body and metadata rather than merging stale fields.
Two independently opened host object readers remain isolated under one reader cancellation; stored content remains.
Conditional get distinguishes metadata-only existing object, matched body and missing key.
Valid ETag compare-and-set updates one version and preserves it after a stale condition refusal.
Wildcard create-only condition across Headers/object inputs and absent-versus-existing object states.
Native R2 structured and header byte ranges retain full object size and do not modify source.
Bounded opaque-cursor pagination without assuming pages fill; ASCII listing order and terminal cursor shape.
Delimiter directory grouping returns direct objects and unique child prefixes as an order-independent set.
Selective metadata projection, with exact empty maps explicitly scoped to celld representation.
Production bucket-name prefix isolation for equal logical keys and deletion.
Bulk R2 selected deletion is idempotent and preserves an unrequested neighbor.
Public key-to-object-path mapping preserves empty segments and Unicode roundtrip; no non-ASCII sort claim.
Correct supplied SHA-256 and default MD5 digest records survive write/head conversion.
One valid final multipart part completes into an ordinary stored object with creation metadata.
Uncommitted multipart data and ordinary abort preserve an existing object.
Same-active-request resume handle attaches to its own upload and completes it; no cross-request capability, restart or cross-node claim.
